model.comparison: The rule ranks need, not success probability, so it is not scored against this label. The honest comparison for this model is the majority class.
model.caveat: Leave-one-out over 51 attempts. The interval on an accuracy from this many folds is wide; treat the comparison as a sanity check, not a measurement.
